description.en:
Lock the joints of double trailers so they stay straight, making it possible to reverse with a dolly or a turntable drawbar trailer.
Press ALT + L while driving to lock / unlock.
What gets locked (only the side-to-side turning, trailers can still follow bumps): - the turntable (front axle) of drawbar trailers - dolly -> trailer and trailer -> trailer connections The hitch on your tractor always stays free.
